sources.title: GitHub - AI4SGI/ExoMind: Official repository for ExoMind
sources.snippet: Built on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, ExoMind achieves substantial and consistent improvements across scientific reasoning and research tasks using less data, a small model, and low-cost training. Its average score across eight scientific benchmarks increases from 36.2 to 67.5, while it also improves over the base model on all six evaluated general-capability benchmarks.

sources.title: ExoMind: Democratizing Scientific Intelligence
sources.snippet: ExoMind is the first extended-mind-inspired agentic system, integrating systematic data engineering, a scientific interaction framework, and a systematic training strategy to advance scientific reasoning and research.
